title: Selected pickup and incapacitated character direction (partial owner regression correction)
acceptance_criteria: Selected pickup validates current exact eligible target, reach and block LOS without requiring a current look-ray hit; automatic candidate discovery remains ray-limited.
Selected jug pickup after lateral target motion succeeds through the production transfer route; wall denial preserves the hand and original entity.
Critical/dead character voluntary facing is denied by shared medical direction permission; healthy external movement does not deny facing and recovery restores it.
Canonical player mouse production accepted intent cannot turn its critical physical body; healthy recovery restores voluntary turn.

Fresh native regressions, medical direction JVM tests and affected interaction/prediction readiness pass before packaging. Hand-transfer escape and camera/observer presentation fixes are explicitly not included.
manual_steps: Make an AI and a playable mouse critical; check repeated voluntary facing stops, then heal and check facing returns.
Throw a jug and a mouse past another player; click their visible bodies to catch them. Targets currently beyond reach or behind a wall should still be denied.
While a healthy mouse is held or flying, check look input still works. Camera jitter, drop glide and remote jump landing appearance remain unresolved; report them separately.
Same-holder physical hand transfer should preserve escape in SS14, but the local fix is not included. Do not treat this candidate as resolving that report.
